content.title: Blakely Neiman Thornton on Instagram: "We are free for at least a season…"
content.text: We are free for at least a season…Happy to say that I have never watched The Bachelorette or The Bachelor. 👏👏👏White people being held accountable for their own actions is my new favorite genere of scrolling.THEY CANNOT PRETEND THEY DIDNT KNOWHer parents groomed her to be abused and take it. Given everything that was already public about her and her family, especially her abusive ex, I have no idea why she was cast. These shows need to end.Gotta love America, where they rest on plausible deniability, but if there’s a video of the incident, they already knew about well then that’s the line that can’t be crossed.But when a man is an abuser he’s fine. I’m not in this world but this whole discourse has made it clear they really don’t gaf and are just doing this to save face. The whole first season was about this fight and they still put her everywhere. 🙄🤷🏻‍♀️This is classless. I am going to go watch my Tyler Perry show because I like my ghetto FICTIONALIZEDHaving “Disney” and “The Bachelorette” in the same sentence is still bizarre to me.hahaha whatd she do i dont follow that particular cultSomeone fill me in, I’m not a fan of the series, never watched it except in parody form. What happened? I’d rather a human tell me, rather than an ai article some publication generated.Can we talk about how she’d be fighting DCFS to get her kids back if she was Black or Brown? 📢😑I'm wondering why they cast her in the first place. Did they not watch her show?I was going to watch this season as my first season of the franchise cuz it was finally messy enough for me to care. This feels like how I saw a woman get T-boned pulling to the Target parking lot recently. I ran over to check on her and first thing she said was, “I’m ok…I’m just embarrassed cuz I KNEW better than to break my boycott! Now I’m gonna have to admit I was here.” Jesus took that wheel!Honestly, even before the new DV charges, just the things we know about her personal life would have disqualified anyone other woman from being The Bachelorette. This was a bad pick to begin with & the only reason ABC picked her was because they thought the popularity of Mormon Wives would bring in more/new viewers to the show.
